author: bardic-inspiration
name: Whiskerfang Hunter
summary: An eyeless cave cat with whiskers long as a forearm that feels its prey through the air and strikes before it's noticed.
description: Whiskerfangs prowl the widest caverns, where their whiskers can read the breath of a sleeping traveler from across a chamber. They are utterly silent and patient, and they favor the dark where torchlight dies. Hunters who take one sell the whiskers to diviners, who claim they still twitch when something approaches.

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.text: The hunter has {ref:glossary/advantage} on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn yet in the current combat.

traits.name: Dark Stalker
traits.text: While in {ref:glossary/darkness}, the hunter has {ref:glossary/advantage} on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The hunter makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.
